description: This Java source file defines an exception class named GatewayPlaceholderReferenceNotSupportedException used within the Eclipse Ditto framework. The class represents a specific error condition related to unsupported entity references in requests, including methods for constructing instances from JSON and for building exception details.

classes.name: GatewayPlaceholderReferenceNotSupportedException
classes.description: An exception indicating a request references an unsupported entity type; it extends DittoRuntimeException and implements GatewayException.

classes.name: GatewayPlaceholderReferenceNotSupportedException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of GatewayPlaceholderReferenceNotSupportedException with a fluent API.

methods.name: fromUnsupportedEntityType
methods.description: Creates a builder for the exception, provided with the unsupported entity type and the set of supported entity types.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object containing error details.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a copy of the exception with new DittoHeaders.
